title: CheckProjectWriteableToGithub
description: setup-project: look up a user-owned project and whether the bot can write to it. A POST /graphql whose JSON body is this, exactly as sent: the operation text byte for byte, plus its variables (values are never written into the operation text). The token goes in the Authorization header with Accept: application/vnd.github+json and X-GitHub-Api-Version: 2022-11-28.

login.description: The project owner's login, from the project URL.

number.description: The project number, from the project URL; at most GraphQL's largest Int.
